name: BSP_D3D9_TranslateResourceFlags
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Two stack arguments (engine resource flags, resource kind), RET 8, and two out-parameters in registers: EDX receives a D3DPOOL and ECX a D3DUSAGE mask (stored at 00b20b6e). Pool comes from flags & 0Fh through the jump table at 00b20b78: 0 -> D3DPOOL_DEFAULT, 1, 2, 3. Usage bits accumulate from flags & 0F00h (100h -> D3DUSAGE_DEPTHSTENCIL 2 at 00b20af8, 200h -> 4000h, 300h -> 40h, 400h -> 100h, 500h -> 80h), flags & 0F000h == 1000h -> D3DUSAGE_DYNAMIC 200h, flags & 0F0000h == 10000h -> D3DUSAGE_WRITEONLY 8, and for resource kind 3 or 5 with flags & 0FF000000h == 1000000h -> D3DUSAGE_AUTOGENMIPMAP 400h. Its one caller in this packet is the renderer virtual +F8h wrapper 00b21ec0, which forwards the usage to IDirect3D9::CheckDeviceFormat and ignores the pool. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_RENDERER.md; reports/app_init_renderer.json.
